positionConvention: One-based decimal positions; the integer 3 and decimal point are excluded.
samplingNotes: All 1,000,000,000 source bytes were validated as ASCII decimal digits, with bounded streaming reads.
The user-provided ZIP contains exactly one entry, 1b.txt. It begins 1415926535 and contains no initial integer 3, decimal point, whitespace, or other non-digits.
The first 100,000,000 decimal digits match the previous user-provided 100m.zip dataset byte-for-byte by SHA-256.
The previous 100-million-digit prefix was independently verified against MIT SIPB and pi.delivery.
50-digit windows at decimal positions 200000000, 500000000, and 999999951 matched https://api.pi.delivery/v1/pi on 2026-11-07 (America/New_York). The API uses start=1 for the first decimal digit.
Each of the 1,000 stored compressed files was read back, decompressed, and compared byte-for-byte with its source chunk.
Existing prefix chunks are retained when their decompressed bytes match the new source, preserving browser-cache compatibility.
originalSha256 and decimalsSha256 apply to the unmodified 1,000,000,000 bytes of the user-provided 1b.txt.
